title: Pack and unpack an archive of many small files
summary: Pack tens to hundreds of small in-memory text files (config, source, locale and data files, 100 bytes to 3 KB each) into one deflate-compressed ZIP archive, then list and extract every entry.
notes: Unlike deflate-roundtrip, where a few large entries make deflate throughput the figure, each archive here holds 40 to 400 small entries, so the per-entry cost (local header, central directory record, compressor and decompressor setup, name handling) is a large share. The JavaScript packages in the category (zip.js, @quentinadam/zip, @deno-library/compress) only offer asynchronous or file-system APIs and are not part of this synchronous task.
